localChanges: A Nuclear unit no longer fights like an ordinary attacker. It detonates when it attacks a rival unit or moves into a rival city, destroying every unit in the 3×3 area (yours too), halving each city there and leaving fallout on the land around it. Other civilizations are told when nuclear weapons are used (closes #129).
A city with SDI Defense keeps its units safe from a nuclear attack, though it is still halved.
